_note: bet365's 6 Scores Challenge selection. bet365 PRE-SELECT the six Premier League fixtures each week -- you cannot choose them -- and there is no feed for them, so this file is filled in from their published list. Keys are 'Home|Away' in CANONICAL club names as they appear in data/leagues/pl.json. Leave `fixtures` empty when the week's six are not published yet: the board then says so rather than inventing a selection.
_expectation: MEASURED, not hoped for. On the held-out season the model's correct-score accuracy in the Premier League is 11.84% per fixture, against 12.37% for simply writing 1-1 on every line (scripts/correct_score_check.py). Expect ~0.7 correct out of 6, with 3+ correct in roughly 3% of weeks. This board is published as an honest test of that, not as a tip sheet.
_source: aceodds.com bet365 6 Scores Challenge page, 2026-09-04 -- all six fixtures dated 5th/6th September 2026 and cross-checked against our own matchweek-3 pl.json schedule (dates/kickoffs match exactly). everytip.co.uk was checked first and rejected: it served last week's matchweek-2 selection (Bournemouth-Everton etc.) unchanged, the exact stale-page failure mode this step warns about.
